kinds.harness-capture: Frames a real, installed harness wrote. Only these can qualify a harness. A file captured in this folder lives under live/ and names its authorization; a transcription of an older recording names its origin.
kinds.sdk-derived: Frames written by hand from a harness SDK's transport source or documentation. They shape the implementation and never qualify a harness.
kinds.synthetic: Frames produced by the Node fake agent (B5) or written to match it. They prove PandaCode's side of the protocol and never qualify a harness.

capture.origin: Pre-existing repository recording of a settings-file UserPromptSubmit hook (claude_stream_tests.rs, a_slow_prompt_hook_counts_as_the_owed_turn_starting). Not made in this run.

gates.reason: Recording Claude Code's initialize.hooks registration and one hook_callback needs a live run of the installed harness, which needs the user's separate, explicit authorization. It has not been given, so Claude-specific hook qualification stays pending. Implementation proceeds against SDK-derived and synthetic frames.
